name: Submit an owner inquiry
description: An owner can send a real inquiry and receive confirmation after persistence.
steps: Open Contact through Let’s talk. Submit the blank form and verify required fields prevent submission.
Fill name Lehigh QA Owner, email lehigh-qa@example.com, and message This is an automated QA consultation request; please ignore. Check the contact consent box.
expected: The thank-you confirmation appears only after the request is saved.

name: Browse rentals and reset filters on mobile
description: Visitors can explore services and filter the current property inventory on a narrow screen.
steps: Open mobile navigation, visit Property management, then About us.
Visit Available rentals. Set Location to Whitehall, bedrooms to 4+, and budget to $1000.
Check that a matching listing or a helpful empty state is shown. Reset filters and verify all three controls return to any/all.
Return Home, expand a FAQ question, then collapse it.
expected: Navigation, filters, reset and FAQ work without horizontal overflow. Empty inventory is clearly explained.

name: Protect employee and admin workflows
description: Anonymous visitors cannot access staff data or editing controls; authentication entry points are usable.
steps: Open Staff sign in. Verify no property editor, staff roster, or inquiry records are visible.
Try signing in with nobody-lehigh-qa@example.com and InvalidPassword123!.
Verify an error is visible and the dashboard is still inaccessible.
Open First time? Activate account and verify email and password fields are offered. Do not submit. Return to sign in.
Open Forgot password and verify the reset email form is shown. Do not send an email. Return to website.
expected: Invalid credentials are rejected. Staff capabilities remain protected, with working activation and recovery entry points.
